title: Stellar Protocol Canary fixture inventory, inventoryVersion 1
description: The `stellar-canary fixtures --format json` inventory contract (CA-02). Required fields follow CA-02 section 3; consumers must ignore properties they do not know: inventoryVersion 1 only grows additively, and this schema therefore sets no `additionalProperties` restrictions.

inventoryVersion.description: The inventory format version. This schema validates version 1 only; an unsupported version makes the whole inventory invalid.

toolVersion.description: The Canary CLI's own semver, independent of inventoryVersion and protocol. Informational; never use it for feature detection.

fixtureFormat.description: The fixture file format the engine reads (1 today).

protocol.description: The Stellar protocol version this inventory lists fixtures for.

directoryFound.description: Whether --fixtures-dir exists as a directory. False is not an error; it reports an empty inventory.

counts.description: Fixture counts for the listed protocol.

otherProtocols.description: Count of fixtures in the directory for every other protocol, keyed by the protocol number as a string.

fixtures.description: One entry per fixture of protocol, sorted by id (comparing UTF-8 bytes).

id.description: The fixture's unique identity across the directory.

protocol.description: The fixture's declared protocol; equals the top-level protocol.

description.description: Human-readable description from the fixture file.

path.description: Path relative to --fixtures-dir with forward slashes on every platform.

requiredCapabilities.description: Sorted list of required capability names (lowercase kebab).

sourceReference.description: Optional source reference (e.g. CAP or URL). Omitted, not null, when absent.

method.description: RPC method value for rpc fixtures.

type.description: XDR type name for xdr fixtures.

kind.description: XDR kind (e.g. decode-success, roundtrip) for xdr fixtures.

function.description: Contract function name for soroban fixtures.

verification.description: The CF-04 verification record, copied as stored. Absent when unverified.

sha256.description: Reserved CF-02 SHA-256 digest of the fixture file bytes.
